title: Implement direct independent V4 Stage execution
goal: Run Bootstrap, Analysis, Pre and Post directly through one package-validated runtime with explicit prerequisites and project-confined evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: All four stable Stage identities execute directly through one uniform command and result contract.
Each Stage resolves its declared input itself and reports a missing prerequisite without hidden earlier-stage execution.
Synthetic blocking findings and runtime/prerequisite failures produce distinct structured exit categories.
Stage and module evidence is written only beneath the bound project EvidenceRoot claim.
The synthetic profile exercises all four Stages while the default profile remains deterministic and empty.
P0/P1/P2 and current V3 validation remain green with no active workflow or remote change.
